title: 일정 학습률 학습 뒤 감쇠 시작 시점의 저랭크 분해(K2)와 감쇠 구간 학습: 150에폭 경량 C2MS-SP 단일 시드 확인
hypothesis: Train the full C2MS at a constant lr 1e-4 for 120 epochs (as the 84 trunk), factorize it into the 83 K2 structure (66% MACs) at the start of the decay, and spend the 30-epoch cosine decay on the K2 model. The decay then doubles as the recovery fine-tuning, so with the same 150-epoch budget as C2MS-SP the K2 model keeps most of the 84 schedule gain (B150 vs C2MS-SP seed 42: QB +0.060, GF2 +0.184, WV3 +0.342 dB) minus the factorization cost (Lite seed 42 vs C2MS-SP: QB -0.026, GF2 -0.058, WV3 -0.010 dB) and beats the same-seed C2MS-SP on RR.

evidence.84_B150: same 150 epochs, WSD (120 constant + 30 decay) instead of cosine: B150+P vs C2MS-SP seed 42 QB +0.060, GF2 +0.184, WV3 +0.342 dB
evidence.83_K2: C2MS-SP-Lite = 65 weights -> K2 factorization -> 10 epochs at 5e-5; seed 42 vs C2MS-SP QB -0.026, GF2 -0.058, WV3 -0.010 dB; most of the loss recovered in the first epoch
evidence.87: channel-width reduction + 20 epochs, seed 42 vs C2MS-SP: B32W96 QB -0.076, GF2 -0.253, WV3 -0.146; B32W64 -0.236, -0.510, -0.443 dB (best epoch 19-20). Width reduction loses far more than K2, so 88 uses K2
evidence.86: fast K10 projection identical to the 79 projection (max 1.3e-14); with CUDA Graphs + FP16 the network time of C2MS and K2 is equal
evidence.budget: 150 epochs for every sensor, the C2MS-SP budget; no per-sensor length chosen from 84 test results

arms.TRUNK: C2MS (C2MS-SP structure), 65 loss, Adam 1e-4 constant, 120 epochs from the seed-42 initialization; shared start of every branch
arms.FULL: TRUNK epoch 120 state -> 30-epoch cosine decay 1e-4 -> 1e-6 on the full model (re-run of 84 B150; same-trunk reference)
arms.K2D: official candidate. TRUNK epoch 120 weights -> 83 K2 factorization -> 30-epoch cosine decay 1e-4 -> 1e-6 on K2 with a new Adam (data order, RNG and GradScaler continue)
arms.K2F: reference. FULL best -> 83 K2 factorization -> the Lite recipe (10 epochs, Adam 5e-5 -> 1e-6 cosine); total 160 epochs; tells whether factorizing before or after the decay is better

epochs_note: trainer epoch counts: FULL continues the TRUNK epoch counter (120 trunk + 30 decay = 150); K2D and K2F count their own epochs from the factorized weights (epoch 0 = factorized, before any update)
schedule: TRUNK: lr = lr_start (1e-4). FULL, K2D, K2F: lr = 1e-6 + 0.5 (lr_peak - 1e-6)(1 + cos(pi j / (D - 1))), j = epoch - decay_start, D = epochs - decay_start (FULL 30 from epoch 120, K2D 30, K2F 10)
factorization: 83 model.factorize(base, 'K2', sigma): backbone 8 convs 64->64 3x3 -> 3x3 64->32 (no bias) + 1x1 32->64 by activation-aware truncated SVD over 512 training patches (fixed generator, seed 0); W2 16 convs 128->128 3x3 -> 1x1 128->384, depthwise 3x3 (384), 1x1 384->128 by CP-ALS rank 384 (150 iterations, seed 0). K2D factorizes the TRUNK epoch-120 weights (latest, not best); K2F the FULL best
init_record: runtime/init/<sensor>_<arm>_s<seed>.pt (factorized weights) and .json (SHA-256, source, report), written by run.py --mode factorize when the source run is complete; the trainer loads K2D/K2F only from a file whose hash equals its record

selection.TRUNK: minimum original-scale validation MSE over epochs 0..120 (reference only)
selection.FULL: minimum validation MSE over the trunk epochs and the decay epochs (as 84)
selection.K2D: minimum validation MSE over the K2 epochs 0..30 (0 = factorized before any update); trunk epochs are a different structure and are not candidates
selection.K2F: minimum validation MSE over epochs 0..10 (0 = factorized FULL best)
selection.rule: earliest exact tie; test never used for selection

control_note: C2MS-SP = 65 C2MS_L1S (150-epoch cosine) of the same seed + K10 projection (on WV2 also the 82 band calibration)
projection: 86 FastProjectedV2: K10 float64 with the test sensor operator, FFT adjoint

comparisons.official: K2D + P vs the same-seed C2MS-SP (65 + P), per training sensor, seed 42, v2.4 RR (single-seed threshold 0.06 dB); improvement only if QB, GF2 and WV3 all are
comparisons.lite: K2D + P vs C2MS-SP-Lite (83 K2 + P) seed 42: same structure and inference cost, so this is the effect of the training recipe (reference)
comparisons.non_inferior: K2D + P within -0.04 dB of C2MS-SP on every sensor is reported as light non-inferior (not a judgement)
comparisons.reference: K2D vs FULL (factorization cost inside this schedule), K2F vs K2D (factorize before or after the decay), K2F vs Lite (parent effect), FULL vs 84 B150 (re-run spread)
comparisons.transfer: WV3 runs on WV2 with the 82 calibration + P (reference only)
comparisons.cost: used parameters, 256^2 MACs, GPU time at 256^2 and 512^2 in the official setting and the 86 graph_fp16 setting; training GPU hours vs C2MS-SP and Lite

stages.1: TRUNK on QB, GF2, WV3 (two at once), epoch-120 state saved with hashes
stages.2: per sensor: FULL and K2D from the epoch-120 state (two at once), then K2F from the FULL best
stages.3: evaluation (validation-selected weights + P, RR/FR test, WV2 transfer), summary and timing

expected_duration: about 11-12 h on the RTX 3060 Ti (TRUNK 3 x 120 epochs, FULL and K2D 3 x 30, K2F 3 x 10; two at once, 84/83 epoch times) plus about 1 h of evaluation (estimate)
next: if K2D is an improvement or light non-inferior: same recipe with seeds 43 and 44 before any baseline decision (3 seeds required); the baseline change itself is the user's decision
limits: single seed: a positive result needs seeds 43 and 44 before any baseline decision
QB: 84 B150 was +0.060 dB, at the threshold; after the factorization cost QB may stay within noise

K2D starts a new Adam at lr 1e-4 right after the factorization; 83 used 5e-5 after a fully decayed model, so the first decay epochs may lose part of the factorized solution (epoch 0 is a selection candidate)
precision: FP16 AMP training with GradScaler; FP32 loss, validation and evaluation; factorization in float32 with float64 accumulation

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained runs are also evaluated on WV2 with the 82 per-band calibration (reference only under v2.4)

loss: 65 loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + 0.46 x spectral loss on the original pair (history fields train_mse/coarse_train_mse hold mean absolute errors)
ema_note: EMA recorded only (as 65); selection uses the online weights
scenes_note: fixed QB scene indices reused on GF2, WV3 and WV2 (as 65/80); images for seed 42 only

latency.setting: one process, no training on the GPU, batch 1, test scene 0 (RR 256^2, FR 512^2), float32, TF32 off, cuDNN deterministic, autotune off, NCHW; 5 warm-up, 50 timed runs per system interleaved, 3 rounds, median of the round medians
latency.reference: cuDNN autotune + TF32 and FP16 autocast timings and the FP16 RR change (never a judgement)
